# Relux Electric

> Relux Electric is India's leading EV (Electric Vehicle) Charging Station Network Provider, DC Fast Charger Manufacturer, and Franchise Operator headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Relux delivers end-to-end sustainable charging infrastructure across national highways, tier-1, tier-2, and tier-3 cities throughout India.

## Company Factsheet & Entity Data
- **Official Legal Name**: Relux Electric India Private Limited
- **Brand Name**: Relux Electric
- **Industry**: EV Charging Infrastructure, Green Mobility, CleanTech, Energy
- **Headquarters**: No:16/8, PRV Towers, Ground floor, Grand Southern Trunk Rd, Ramapuram, Guindy, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600032, India
- **Customer Support Phone**: +91-9884866993
- **Official Email**: enquiry@reluxelectric.com
- **Official Website**: [Relux Electric Homepage](https://reluxelectric.com)
- **Driver Mobile App**: Relux EV App (Available on Android & iOS)

## Key Business & Partnership Programs
- [EV Charging Station Franchise](https://reluxelectric.com/business/franchise): Turnkey franchise opportunities for commercial investors starting from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹50+ Lakhs with fast 18 to 36 month payback.
- [Zero Investment Host Partnership](https://reluxelectric.com/business/zero-investment): Landowners, hotel operators, and highway restaurants host Relux fast chargers with 0% capital expenditure and earn monthly revenue share.
- [Fleet & Commercial Solutions](https://reluxelectric.com/business/service): High-voltage charging hubs for electric bus depots, logistics fleets, ride-hailing operators, and corporate parks.

## Hardware & Products Catalog
- [LAX 30 DC Fast Charger](https://reluxelectric.com/business/products): 30kW Single/Dual Gun DC Fast Charger. Ideal for retail malls, restaurants, and commercial complexes.
- [LAX 60 DC Fast Charger](https://reluxelectric.com/business/products): 60kW Dual Gun DC Fast Charger (CCS2). High-demand highway charging standard.
- [SIMHA 120 Ultra-Fast Charger](https://reluxelectric.com/business/products): 120kW Dual Gun Ultra-Fast DC Charger (CCS2). Charges EVs in 20-30 minutes.
- [SIMHA 240 Hyper Charger](https://reluxelectric.com/business/products): 240kW Rapid Charger for heavy commercial vehicles, electric buses, and fleet depots.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Which is the best EV charging station franchise in India?**
  A: Relux Electric is rated among India's top EV franchise providers due to Make-in-India DC fast chargers, low setup cost, fast 18-36 month ROI, and central CMS platform.
- **Q: How much does it cost to set up an EV charging station with Relux?**
  A: Setup cost ranges from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹50+ Lakhs depending on charger power capacity (30kW, 60kW, 120kW, 240kW) and grid setup.
- **Q: Can I host an EV charging station on my land for free?**
  A: Yes, through the [Zero Investment Host Program](https://reluxelectric.com/business/zero-investment), eligible landowners host fast chargers with ₹0 upfront cost.
